positive.prompt: We want to build something for tracking field service visits — can you interview me and figure out what DocTypes we actually need?
I have an idea for a customer warranty claims portal but I'm not sure what DocTypes or roles we need — can you grill me on it?
Build me a rental equipment management module
Stress-test this idea: replace our paper job cards with a Frappe app that assigns work to technicians

negative.prompt: Write the spec for a Service Request DocType — it has subject, customer, assigned_to, and status fields, with a Manager approval workflow
Break this completed spec into ordered implementation tasks I can hand to agents

evals.prompt: I want to build something in Frappe for tracking subcontractor work orders. I'm not sure what shape it should take — whether it's a new DocType, a child table, or something that extends an existing ERPNext document. Can you interview me?
evals.expected_output: A one-question-at-a-time interview that surfaces DocTypes, roles, workflow states, and scope, ending in a structured requirements brief
expectations: The agent asks no more than one question at a time
Questions cover at minimum: who uses this, what DocTypes or existing records it connects to, what actions users take, and what success looks like
The agent checks installed apps and version before proposing a shape (child table vs standalone DocType vs ERPNext extension)
The session ends with a requirements brief that names DocTypes, roles, workflow states, and any out-of-scope items
No spec or DocType code is written during the interview

evals.prompt: Refine this idea: 'a portal where our customers can see their delivery status and raise a complaint if something is wrong'. I'm not sure if it's a web form, a portal page, or something else.
evals.expected_output: A divergent/convergent refinement that explores options and narrows to a recommended shape, asking about roles and workflow before proposing anything
expectations: The agent explores multiple plausible shapes (web form vs portal page vs custom SPA) before settling on one
At least one clarifying question targets who the portal users are and whether they need a Frappe login
The agent checks whether frappe-web-forms or frappe-frontend-development is the right next step before ending
The output is a refined idea summary, not a coded implementation
